Standard: The air vehicle's bank angle response to sideslip in forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) does not have an opposing increase in bank angle opposite the commanded sideslip unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the bank angle response to sideslip as specified in MIL-DTL- 32742, Bank Angle in Steady Sideslips paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the bank angle response to sideslip as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Bank Angle in Steady Sideslips paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the bank angle response to sideslip as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Bank Angle in Steady Sideslips paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
